fusions.name: Drag Furrow
fusions.desc: Combs the ground in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to every enemy in it. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Tine Jab
fusions.desc: Jabs for 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gather In
fusions.desc: Up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tidy Ground
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
